label: 2296-own-used-paper1093-deploy-targets-open
command: (async()=>{if(location.pathname!=='/paper/detail.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('paperId')!=='1093'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Own used paper only');const modal=document.getElementById('paperDeployModal'),button=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-target]')].find(e=>e.dataset.bsTarget==='#paperDeployModal');if(!button||button.matches(':disabled'))throw Error('Deploy entry unavailable');const shown=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Paper deploy shown timeout')),5000);modal.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});});button.click();await shown;return {modal:modal.id,text:modal.innerText,targets:[...modal.querySelectorAll('[name=deployTargets]')].map(e=>({value:e.value,disabled:e.matches(':disabled'),checked:e.checked})),confirmDisabled:modal.querySelector('[data-action-ok]').matches(':disabled'),lookupLinks:[...modal.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].map(e=>({text:e.innerText,href:e.getAttribute('href'),target:e.target})),deploymentSubmitted:false};})()
